annotation.justification: The clause is clear in its requirements: when the spin bit is disabled, endpoints have the option to set it to any value (MAY), and they must not act on the incoming spin bit value (MUST ignore). There is no ambiguity in the operational behavior required of endpoints. The use of 'MAY' allows flexibility but does not introduce conflicting or materially different interpretations.
